content.title: About
content.content: Strawberry milk with reduced sugar is a dairy‑based beverage flavored with natural strawberry extract and lightly sweetened with sugar substitutes. It retains the creamy taste of milk and a subtle berry note while containing far less sugar than conventional fruit‑flavored milks.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The strawberry flavor is derived from real strawberries, not artificial aromatics.
Sugar reduction is achieved using stevia and erythritol, which do not raise blood glucose.
The drink is fortified with calcium and vitamin D, just like regular milk.
It suits people watching their sugar intake but is not completely carb‑free.
Packaging is often made from recyclable plastic to lower environmental impact.

items.title: Low Sugar Content
items.content: Reduced sugar helps control calorie intake and supports stable blood glucose levels.

items.title: Rich in Calcium
items.content: Provides a good source of calcium essential for bone and teeth health.

items.title: Vitamin D
items.content: Vitamin D aids calcium absorption and supports the immune system.

items.title: Probiotics (in some versions)
items.content: Certain formulations include live cultures that promote gut health.

items.title: Low‑Calorie Snack
items.content: Ideal as a light snack or breakfast addition, delivering energy without excess calories.

items.title: Lactose Intolerance
items.content: Contains lactose, so those with intolerance should choose lactose‑free alternatives.

items.title: Milk Allergy
items.content: People allergic to milk proteins may experience reactions.

items.title: Artificial Sweeteners
items.content: While stevia and erythritol are generally safe, they can cause gastrointestinal discomfort in some individuals.

items.title: Residual Sugar
items.content: The product still contains a small amount of sugar; strict low‑sugar diets should account for it.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy strawberry reduced‑sugar milk chilled, add it to smoothies, oatmeal, cereal, or use as a base for desserts. It pairs well with bananas, berries, and nuts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 1 °C–4 °C. Once opened, consume within 5‑7 days. Do not freeze, as texture may change.
